881: O servants of the Lord, through the Guru's teaching help me chant the Lord's Name.
ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸੁਣੈ ਕਹੈ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ; ਰਾਮ ਜਪਤ ਸੋਹਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Whoever hears it or utters it is liberated; chanting the Lord's Name one's life becomes beautiful. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਜੇ ਵਡਭਾਗ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ; ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਜਨਾ ਭੇਟਾਇ ॥
If great destiny is written on one's forehead, the Lord brings him to meet His servants.
ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸੰਤ ਦੇਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਸਭੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
O Lord, in Your mercy grant me the sight of the saints, and all poverty and pain depart. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਗ. ਰਾਮ ਜਨ ਨੀਕੇ; ਭਾਗਹੀਣ. ਨ ਸੁਖਾਇ ॥
The Lord's people, His servants, are sublime, but the unfortunate do not like them.
ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਮ ਕਹਹਿ ਜਨ ਊਚੇ; ਨਰ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਡੰਸੁ ਲਗਾਇ ॥੩॥
The more the servants chant the Lord's Name, the higher they rise, while to the slanderers it is like a snakebite. ॥3॥
ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਨਰ ਨਿੰਦਕ, ਜਿਨ ਜਨ. ਨਹੀ ਭਾਏ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸਖਾ ਸਖਾਇ ॥
Cursed, cursed are the slanderers who do not love the servants, the companions of the Lord.
ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚੋਰ ਵੇਮੁਖ ਮੁਖ ਕਾਲੇ; ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ. ਨ ਭਾਇ ॥੪॥
Those who cannot bear the Guru's honour are thieves of the Lord, turned away, with blackened faces. ॥4॥
ਦਇਆ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ; ਹਮ ਦੀਨ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥
O dear Lord, be merciful and protect us; we meek ones have come to Your refuge.
ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੁਮ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੫॥੨॥
We are Your children, You are our Father, O my God; forgive servant Nanak and unite him with Yourself. ॥5॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸਖਾ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਨੀਕੇ; ਤਿਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਹਾਥੁ ਵਤਾਵੈ ॥
The holy companions of the Lord are sublime; He places His hand over them.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੇਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਏ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Those holy ones who turn to the Guru are pleasing to God; in His mercy He unites them with Himself. ॥1॥
ਰਾਮ; ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮੇਲਿ. ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
O Lord, unite me with Your servants; this is my mind's longing.
ਅਮਿਉ ਅਮਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਹੈ ਮੀਠਾ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The relish of the Lord is sweet nectar; meeting the saints, I long to put it in my mouth. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਗ ਰਾਮ ਜਨ ਊਤਮ; ਮਿਲਿ ਊਤਮ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
The Lord's people, His servants, are exalted; meeting them one attains the exalted state.
ਹਮ ਹੋਵਤ ਚੇਰੀ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੀ; ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਖੁਸੀ ਕਰਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
I am the handmaid of the servants of the servants of those on whom my Master casts His glance of grace. ॥2॥
ਸੇਵਕ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ; ਰਿਦ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਵੈ ॥
Greatly fortunate are the servants who serve Him; He implants love for Himself in their hearts, minds and bodies.
ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤੀ. ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਬਾਤਾ; ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਕੂੜੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
But some, without that love, talk a great deal; speaking falsehood, they reap falsehood. ॥3॥
ਮੋ ਕਉ ਧਾਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਦਾਤੇ; ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਪਗੀ, ਲੇ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
O Lord, Giver of life to the world, be merciful to me, that someone may bring me to the saints' feet.
ਹਉ ਕਾਟਉ ਕਾਟਿ ਬਾਢਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਉ; ਜਿਤੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੰਤੁ ਚੜਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੪॥੩॥
Nanak, say: I would cut off my head, cut it to pieces, and lay it down for the saint to step on and come to me. ॥4॥3॥
ਜੇ ਵਡਭਾਗ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਵਡ ਮੇਰੇ; ਜਨ ਮਿਲਦਿਆ ਢਿਲ. ਨ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
If my great destiny awakens, I should not delay a moment in meeting the Lord's servants.
ਹਰਿ ਜਨ. ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੁੰਟ ਸਰ ਨੀਕੇ; ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਤਿਤੁ ਨਾਵਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
The Lord's servants are beautiful springs and pools of nectar; only by great fortune does one bathe in them. ॥1॥
ਰਾਮ; ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
O Lord, set me to the service of Your servants.
ਹਉ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਖਾ ਪੀਸਉ. ਸੰਤ ਆਗੈ; ਪਗ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੂਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I would carry water, wave the fan and grind the grain for the saints, massage their feet and apply their dust to my forehead. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਵਡੇ ਵਡੇ ਵਡ ਊਚੇ; ਜੋ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ ॥
The Lord's servants are great, very great and exalted, united in the True Guru's company.
ਸਤਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕੋਈ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੨॥
No one is as great as the True Guru; meeting the True Guru one meditates on the Lord. ॥2॥
ਸਤਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ; ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਲਾਜ ਰਖਾਈਐ ॥
Those who sought the True Guru's refuge found the Lord; my Master saved their honour.
ਇਕਿ ਅਪਣੈ ਸੁਆਇ ਆਇ ਬਹਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ; ਜਿਉ ਬਗੁਲ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
But some come and sit before the Guru for their own ends, like a heron sitting in trance. ॥3॥
ਬਗੁਲਾ ਕਾਗ ਨੀਚ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ; ਜਾਇ ਕਰੰਗ ਬਿਖੂ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
Heron and crow love low company; they go and put carrion and filth in their mouths.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਮੇਲਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਤਿ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੰਸੁ ਕਰਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੪॥
Nanak, say: O God, unite me with the Guru's company; joining that company the crow becomes a swan. ॥4॥4॥
882: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ; ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
O Lord, my Beloved, Sovereign of my life, be merciful and unite me with the True Guru.
ਹਮ ਚੇਰੀ ਹੋਇ ਲਗਹ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ; ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪੰਥੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Becoming his handmaid, I would fall at the feet of the Guru who has shown me the path to the Lord God. ॥1॥
ਰਾਮ; ਮੈ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
O Lord, Your Name has become dear to my mind.
ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ਬੇਲੀ; ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਖਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I have no friend but the Lord; the Lord is my father, mother and companion. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਮੇਰੇ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ. ਨ ਰਹਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ; ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ. ਮਰਹਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
O my mother, without my Beloved my life cannot last a moment; without seeing Him I die.
ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਡਭਾਗ. ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਏ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Blessed, blessed, greatly fortunate are those who come to the Guru's refuge; meeting the Guru they have beheld the Lord. ॥2॥
ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ਸੂਝੈ ਬੂਝੈ; ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਉ ਜਪਾਇਆ ॥
I know and understand nothing else; I chant in my mind the Lord's Name as the Guru has me chant.
ਨਾਮਹੀਣ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਨਕਟੇ; ਤਿਨ ਘਸਿ ਘਸਿ ਨਕ ਵਢਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Those without the Name go about shameless, and are disgraced again and again. ॥3॥
ਮੋ ਕਉ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਜੀਵਾਲਿ ਲੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
O Life of the world, my Master, give me spiritual life; keep Your Name enshrined in my heart.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਪੂਰਾ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੫॥
Nanak, the Guru, the Guru, is perfect; meeting the True Guru one meditates on the Name. ॥4॥5॥
ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਵਡਾ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ; ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
The True Guru, the Giver, is the greatest of beings; meeting him one enshrines the Lord in the heart.
ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੀਆ; ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
The one to whom the perfect Guru has given the gift of spiritual life cherishes the Lord's life-giving Name. ॥1॥
ਰਾਮ; ਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ, ਕੰਠਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
O Lord, through the Guru I have strung Your Name round my neck.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣੀ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ; ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਡਭਾਗ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Turning to the Guru I heard Your praise, and it became dear to my mind; blessed, blessed is my great fortune. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ; ਤਾ ਕਾ. ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪਾਰੇ ॥
Three hundred and thirty million gods meditate on Him, but they cannot find His limit or far shore.
ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਾਮ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਮਾਗਹਿ; ਰਿਧਿ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਹਾਥੁ ਪਸਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
With lust in their hearts some beg for women, and with outstretched hands beg for wealth. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਜਪਿ ਜਪੁ ਵਡਾ ਵਡੇਰਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਖਉ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Chant the Lord's praise; this chanting is the greatest of all. Turning to the Guru, I keep it enshrined in my heart.
ਜੇ ਵਡਭਾਗ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਜਪੀਐ; ਹਰਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Only if one is greatly fortunate does one chant it, and the Lord carries him across the terrifying world-ocean. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਨਿਕਟਿ. ਨਿਕਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹੈ; ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਕੰਠਿ ਜਨ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
The Lord's servants are near Him, and the Lord is near His servants; He keeps them hugged close.
ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੮॥
Nanak, the Lord God is our father and mother; we are children, cherished by the Lord. ॥4॥6॥18॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ. ਦੀਨ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ; ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਣੁ ਅਵਗਣੁ. ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਹੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
O Giver to the meek, be merciful; do not consider my virtues or faults.
ਮਾਟੀ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਧੋਪੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਮਾਣਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਏਹੀ ॥੧॥
O Master, how can clay be washed clean? Such is the state of man. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
O my mind, serve the True Guru and find peace.
ਜੋ ਇਛਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ; ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ. ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Whatever you wish, you will receive, and no pain will afflict you again. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਕਾਚੇ ਭਾਡੇ ਸਾਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
He fashioned and honoured these perishable vessels, and placed His light within them.
ਜੈਸਾ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ; ਹਮ ਤੈਸੀ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
As the Creator wrote destiny for us from the start, so we act. ॥2॥
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਥਾਪਿ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ; ਏਹੋ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
Man claims mind and body as his own; this is the cause of coming and going.
ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਸੋ ਚਿਤਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਮੋਹਿ ਅੰਧੁ ਲਪਟਾਣਾ ॥੩॥
He does not remember the One who gave them; the blind man is entangled in attachment. ॥3॥
883: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਸੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣੈ; ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
The God who made it alone knows it; the Lord's mansion is beyond reach.
ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ; ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
Nanak, say: I am Your servant, O Lord; may I worship You and sing Your praises. ॥4॥1॥
ਪਵਹੁ ਚਰਣਾ ਤਲਿ. ਊਪਰਿ ਆਵਹੁ; ਐਸੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਵਹੁ ॥
Fall at the feet of all, and you will rise high; perform such service.
ਆਪਸ ਤੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਸਭ ਜਾਣਹੁ; ਤਉ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥
Know all to be above yourself, and you will find peace in the Lord's court. ॥1॥
O saints, speak such words of the Lord's praise
ਸੁਰ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ. ਨਰ ਦੇਵ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਾ; ਖਿਨੁ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
that gods and men are made pure; turning to the Guru, utter the Word of praise every moment. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਛੋਡਿ. ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਸਹੁ; ਝੂਠਾ ਕਹਹੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Give up attachment to Maya and dwell in the home of poise; call no one bad.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਨਵੈ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ; ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਤਤੁ ਬਿਲੋਈ ॥੨॥
Meet the True Guru and obtain the nine treasures; in this way churn out the essence. ॥2॥
ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਹੁ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਹੁ; ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
Dispel your doubt, turning to the Guru fix your attention on the Lord, and recognise your own self, O brother.
ਨਿਕਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣਹੁ. ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਾਜਰੁ; ਕਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੁਰਾਈ ॥੩॥
Know God to be near and ever present; then to whom could you do harm? ॥3॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ; ਸਹਜੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Meeting the True Guru, the path becomes free, and in poise the Master is met.
ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੇ ਜਨ. ਜਿਨੀ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
Blessed, blessed are those who have found the Lord in this age; servant Nanak is ever a sacrifice to them. ॥4॥2॥
ਆਵਤ ਹਰਖ ਨ ਜਾਵਤ ਦੂਖਾ; ਨਹ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਮਨ ਰੋਗਨੀ ॥
Gain brings no elation and loss no sorrow; no worry afflicts the mind.
ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ; ਤਉ ਉਤਰੀ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਓਗਨੀ ॥੧॥
Since I found the perfect Guru there is ever bliss, and all separation from the Lord has gone. ॥1॥
In this way my mind is joined to the Lord,
ਮੋਹੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਲੋਗੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ; ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
that attachment, grief, disease and worldly shame do not touch it; there it enjoys the relish of the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਸੁਰਗ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਾ. ਮਿਰਤ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਾ; ਪਇਆਲ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਅਲੋਗਨੀ ॥
Heaven, earth and the netherworld all seem pure to it, and no worldly shame touches it.
ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਭੁੰਚੈ; ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨੀ ॥੨॥
Obedient to the Guru, it ever enjoys peace; wherever I look I see the Lord, the Master of virtues. ॥2॥
ਨਹ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ. ਜਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਵਨਾ; ਤਹ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਮੇਦਨੀ ॥
There is no Shiva or Shakti, no water or air, no form, no earth in that state;
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜੋਗ ਕਾ ਤਹਾ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ; ਜਹ ਅਵਿਗਤ ਨਾਥੁ ਅਗਮ ਧਨੀ ॥੩॥
there dwells union with the True Guru, where the unseen, unreachable Master lives. ॥3॥
ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ. ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਗਨੀ ॥
Body and mind are the Lord's, all wealth is the Lord's; which of His virtues can I count?
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਮ ਤੁਮ. ਗੁਰਿ, ਖੋਈ ਹੈ; ਅੰਭੈ ਅੰਭੁ ਮਿਲੋਗਨੀ ॥੪॥੩॥
Nanak says: the Guru has ended "mine" and "yours", and I have merged in Him as water in water. ॥4॥3॥
ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਰਹਤ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ; ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ. ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
It stays apart, beyond the three qualities; seekers and siddhas do not know it.
ਰਤਨ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੰਪੂਰਨ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਖਜਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
The chamber full of the jewels of nectar is in the True Guru's treasury. ॥1॥
It is a wonder that cannot be told:
a treasure beyond the reach of the senses, O brother. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਮੋਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਕਰਣੈ ਜੋਗਾ; ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
No one can put a price on it; what can anyone say or tell of it?
ਕਥਨ ਕਹਣ ਕਉ ਸੋਝੀ ਨਾਹੀ; ਜੋ ਪੇਖੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਣਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
No one has the understanding to describe it; whoever beholds it comes to love it. ॥2॥
ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ; ਕੀਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਬੇਚਾਰਾ ॥
Only the Creator who made it knows it; what can the poor creature do?
ਆਪਣੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ; ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਪੂਰ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
He alone knows His own state and extent; the Lord Himself is the overflowing treasury. ॥3॥
ਐਸਾ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਖਿਆ; ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਈ ॥
I have tasted such nectar in my mind that I am wholly sated.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਮੇਰੀ ਆਸਾ ਪੂਰੀ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੪॥੪॥
Nanak says: in the True Guru's refuge my hope is fulfilled. ॥4॥4॥
884: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੈ; ਬੈਰੀ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਾਧੇ ॥
God has taken my side and brought all my enemies under control.
ਜਿਨਿ ਬੈਰੀ ਹੈ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਲੂਟਿਆ; ਤੇ ਬੈਰੀ ਲੈ ਬਾਧੇ ॥੧॥
The enemies who plundered this world He has seized and bound. ॥1॥
The True Guru, the Transcendent Lord, is my protector.
ਅਨਿਕ ਰਾਜ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ ਮਾਣੀ; ਨਾਉ ਜਪੀ. ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I enjoy countless royal pleasures and delights; I repeat Your Name, and my trust is in You. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਸਿ. ਦੂਜੀ ਬਾਤਾ; ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਰਖਵਾਰਾ ॥
No other thought comes into the mind of the one over whose head the Lord is protector.
ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਰਹਤ ਹੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਇਕ ਨਾਮ ਕੈ ਆਧਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
O Master, with the support of Your Name alone he stays free of want. ॥2॥
ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਇ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ; ਊਨ. ਨ ਕਾਈ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
The one who meets the Giver of peace becomes complete and lacks nothing.
ਤਤੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਛੋਡਿ. ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
He finds the essence, the sublime, the supreme state, and leaves it to go nowhere else. ॥3॥
ਬਰਨਿ. ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਜੈਸਾ ਤੂ ਹੈ; ਸਾਚੇ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
O True One, unseen and infinite, I cannot describe what You are like.
ਅਤੁਲ ਅਥਾਹ ਅਡੋਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਨਾਨਕ ਖਸਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
Nanak, say: O incomparable, unfathomable, unwavering Master, You are my Husband. ॥4॥5॥
ਤੂ ਦਾਨਾ. ਤੂ ਅਬਿਚਲੁ ਤੂਹੀ; ਤੂ ਜਾਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਪਾਤੀ ॥
You are wise, You are eternal; You are my caste and my lineage.
ਤੂ ਅਡੋਲੁ. ਕਦੇ ਡੋਲਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ; ਤਾ ਹਮ ਕੈਸੀ ਤਾਤੀ ॥੧॥
You are unwavering and never waver; then what worry can I have? ॥1॥
You alone, You alone, You alone are the One.
You alone, O Sovereign Lord, are the One.
ਤਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ; ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By Your mercy we find peace. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਤੂ ਸਾਗਰੁ. ਹਮ ਹੰਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ; ਤੁਮ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਣਕ ਲਾਲਾ ॥
You are the ocean and we are Your swans; in You are pearls and rubies.
ਤੁਮ ਦੇਵਹੁ. ਤਿਲੁ ਸੰਕ, ਨ ਮਾਨਹੁ; ਹਮ ਭੁੰਚਹ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
You give them without the least hesitation, and we enjoy them, ever in bliss. ॥2॥
ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ. ਤੁਮ ਪਿਤਾ ਹਮਾਰੇ; ਤੁਮ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਖੀਰਾ ॥
We are Your children and You are our father; You put milk into our mouths.
ਹਮ ਖੇਲਹ ਸਭਿ ਲਾਡ ਲਡਾਵਹ; ਤੁਮ ਸਦ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥੩॥
We play and make all our childish fuss, and You, the Master of virtues, are ever patient. ॥3॥
ਤੁਮ ਪੂਰਨ. ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਸੰਪੂਰਨ; ਹਮ ਭੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਅਘਾਏ ॥
You are perfect, pervading everywhere completely; with You we too are sated.
ਮਿਲਤ ਮਿਲਤ ਮਿਲਤ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਣੁ. ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੪॥੬॥
Nanak, the one who keeps striving to meet Him stays merged in Him; that state cannot be described. ॥4॥6॥
ਕਰ ਕਰਿ ਤਾਲ ਪਖਾਵਜੁ ਨੈਨਹੁ; ਮਾਥੈ ਵਜਹਿ ਰਬਾਬਾ ॥
Making hands into cymbals and eyes into drums, with destiny on the forehead playing like a rebec,
ਕਰਨਹੁ ਮਧੁ ਬਾਸੁਰੀ ਬਾਜੈ; ਜਿਹਵਾ ਧੁਨਿ ਆਗਾਜਾ ॥
with the sweet flute of Maya sounding in the ears and the tongue's craving as the song,
ਨਿਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਨਾਚੈ; ਆਣੇ ਘੂਘਰ ਸਾਜਾ ॥੧॥
the mind dances, with past deeds as its ankle-bells and instruments. ॥1॥
This is the Lord's dance of creation.
ਪੇਖੈ ਪੇਖਨਹਾਰੁ ਦਇਆਲਾ; ਜੇਤਾ ਸਾਜੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The merciful Lord, who sees all, watches all this array and adornment. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਆਖਾਰ ਮੰਡਲੀ ਧਰਣਿ ਸਬਾਈ; ਊਪਰਿ ਗਗਨੁ ਚੰਦੋਆ ॥
The whole earth is the stage, with the sky as a canopy above.
ਪਵਨੁ ਵਿਚੋਲਾ. ਕਰਤ ਇਕੇਲਾ; ਜਲ ਤੇ ਓਪਤਿ ਹੋਆ ॥
The breath is the go-between that joins soul and the body born of water.
ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਪੁਤਰਾ ਕੀਨਾ; ਕਿਰਤ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਆ ॥੨॥
Of the five elements the puppet of the body was made, joined according to past deeds. ॥2॥
ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ. ਜਰੇ ਚਰਾਗਾ; ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
Sun and moon, two lamps, burn, set to light all four directions.
ਦਸ ਪਾਤਉ, ਪੰਚ ਸੰਗੀਤਾ; ਏਕੈ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਾਥੇ ॥
The ten senses and five passions, like musicians, are together in one body.
ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿੰਨ ਹੋਇ ਭਾਵ ਦਿਖਾਵਹਿ; ਸਭਹੁ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ਭਾਖੇ ॥੩॥
Each shows its own moods, each with its own different urge. ॥3॥
ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਨਿਰਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਾਜੈ ਤੂਰਾ ॥
In every home the dance goes on day and night; in every body the trumpet of Maya sounds.
ਏਕਿ ਨਚਾਵਹਿ. ਏਕਿ ਭਵਾਵਹਿ; ਇਕਿ ਆਇ ਜਾਇ ਹੋਇ ਧੂਰਾ ॥
Some it makes dance, some it makes wander; many are ruined and keep coming and going.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੋ ਬਹੁਰਿ, ਨ ਨਾਚੈ; ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੪॥੭॥
Nanak says: the one who meets the perfect Guru does not dance again. ॥4॥7॥
885: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਏਕ ਧੁਨਿ ਏਕੈ; ਏਕੈ ਰਾਗੁ ਅਲਾਪੈ ॥
He keeps his attention on the One Lord alone, and sings the song of the One alone;
ਏਕਾ ਦੇਸੀ. ਏਕੁ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ; ਏਕੋ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
he dwells in the One, teaches of the One, and sees the One pervading all;
ਏਕਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ. ਏਕਾ ਹੀ ਸੇਵਾ; ਏਕੋ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੧॥
his attention is on the One, his service is to the One; through the Guru he repeats the One. ॥1॥
Good, good is such a singer of the Lord's praises,
who sings the praises of the all-pervading Lord,
ਛੋਡਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਧੰਧ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
giving up the affairs and self-interest of Maya. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਪੰਚ ਬਜਿਤ੍ਰ ਕਰੇ ਸੰਤੋਖਾ; ਸਾਤ ਸੁਰਾ ਲੈ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
He makes contentment his five instruments, and walking the world's ways while absorbed in the Lord is his seven notes.
ਬਾਜਾ ਮਾਣੁ ਤਾਣੁ ਤਜਿ ਤਾਨਾ; ਪਾਉ. ਨ ਬੀਗਾ ਘਾਲੈ ॥
Giving up pride in his own strength is his music, and never setting foot on the wrong path is his melody.
ਫੇਰੀ ਫੇਰੁ. ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਬ ਹੀ; ਏਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੰਧਿ ਪਾਲੈ ॥੨॥
He keeps the Guru's One Word tied in his lap, and so never goes round the cycle of birth again; this is his dancing turn. ॥2॥
Knowing the Lord ever present is his dance of devotion like Narad's.
Giving up all worries is the jingle of his ankle-bells.
He shows the moods of the dance by enjoying the bliss of poise.
The one who dances this dance is not born again. ॥3॥
If someone becomes pleasing to his Master,
he, one among millions, sings this praise.
I seek the support of the holy congregation,
Nanak says, whose one support is the Lord's praise. ॥4॥8॥
ਕੋਈ ਬੋਲੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ; ਕੋਈ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥
Some call Him Ram, some Khuda.
Some serve Him as Gosain, some as Allah. ॥1॥
O Cause of all causes, Generous Lord,
be merciful, O Compassionate One. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਕੋਈ ਨਾਵੈ ਤੀਰਥਿ; ਕੋਈ ਹਜ ਜਾਇ ॥
Some bathe at pilgrim places, some go on Hajj.
ਕੋਈ ਕਰੈ ਪੂਜਾ; ਕੋਈ ਸਿਰੁ ਨਿਵਾਇ ॥੨॥
Some perform worship, some bow their heads in prayer. ॥2॥
Some read the Vedas, some the Semitic scriptures.
ਕੋਈ ਕਹੈ ਤੁਰਕੁ; ਕੋਈ ਕਹੈ ਹਿੰਦੂ ॥
Some call themselves Muslim, some Hindu.
Some long for bahisht, some for swarga. ॥4॥
Nanak says: the one who has recognised the Lord's command
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕਾ; ਤਿਨਿ ਭੇਦੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੫॥੯॥
has come to know the secret of God the Master. ॥5॥9॥
The breath merges into the air,
the light merges into the Light,
the clay becomes one with the clay;
what is there for the mourner to lean on? ॥1॥
Who has died, O brother, who has died?
ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ; ਇਹੁ ਤਉ ਚਲਤੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Meet with those who know God and reflect: this is only a play that has taken place. ॥1॥ Rahao
The mourner knows nothing of what lies ahead;
the one who weeps will also rise and depart.
Beings are bound by the bonds of doubt and attachment.
It has all become a dream, and the blind man raves in vain. ॥2॥
The Creator has staged this creation as a play.
By His infinite command beings come and go.
ਨਹ ਕੋ ਮੂਆ; ਨ ਮਰਣੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
No one dies; the soul is not capable of dying.
It does not perish; it is imperishable. ॥3॥
ਜੋ ਇਹੁ ਜਾਣਹੁ; ਸੋ ਇਹੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
What you think it is, it is not.
I am a sacrifice to the one who knows this.
Nanak says: the one whose doubt the Guru has dispelled
ਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਮਰੈ; ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
neither dies nor comes and goes. ॥4॥10॥
Meditate on the Lord of the universe, the beloved Sustainer of the world.
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਤੂ ਜੀਵਹਿ; ਫਿਰਿ. ਨ ਖਾਈ ਮਹਾ ਕਾਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Remembering the Lord's Name you will live spiritually, and great Death will not devour you again. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ; ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਇਓ ॥
Wandering, wandering through millions of births, you have come here;
886: and by great good fortune have found the company of the holy. ॥1॥
Without the perfect Guru there is no salvation;
Baba Nanak tells you this after reflection. ॥2॥11॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
The four Vedas proclaim it, but you do not believe;
the six Shastras too speak of the one thing;
the eighteen Puranas together speak of the One;
ਤਾ ਭੀ ਜੋਗੀ; ਭੇਦੁ. ਨ ਲਹਿਆ ॥੧॥
even so, O yogi, you have not grasped the secret. ॥1॥
The incomparable harp of the Lord is playing in every heart,
O yogi, intoxicated with your own little harp. ॥1॥ Rahao
You think that in the first age the town of truth was settled,
that in the third age it cracked a little,
that in the second only half remained,
and now only one remains, and so one path has been shown. ॥2॥
All the beads are strung on one thread;
ਗਾਠੀ ਭਿਨਿ ਭਿਨਿ; ਭਿਨਿ ਭਿਨਿ ਤਣੀਏ ॥
knots of many kinds separate them, each in its place.
The rosary turns in many ways and moods,
but when the thread is drawn out, all the beads come together into one place. ॥3॥
ਚਹੁ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੈ; ਮਟੁ ਹੈ ਕੀਆ ॥
Through all four ages the One Lord has made this world His monastery.
In it are many treacherous places and many windows of birth.
Searching and searching, when one comes to the Guru's door,
ਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜੋਗੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
then, Nanak, the yogi attains the mansion, the home of the Lord. ॥4॥
In this way the incomparable harp is heard playing;
ਸੁਣਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਮੀਠੀ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥੧੨॥
hearing it, the yogi's mind finds it sweet. ॥1॥ Second Rahao ॥1॥12॥
The Lord made the nerves the thread and stitched the patches of the body together;
the sinews are the stitches and the bones the needle.
From a drop of fluid He set up the staff of the body.
O yogi, why are you proud of your patched coat? ॥1॥
Meditate on the Master day and night;
your patched coat lasts only two days. ॥1॥ Rahao
Smearing yourself thickly with ashes, you sit in trance;
you wear earrings, but "mine and yours" dwells within you.
You beg for scraps of bread but find no contentment;
ਨਾਥੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਚਹਿ; ਲਾਜ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
forsaking the Master you beg from others and feel no shame. ॥2॥
O yogi, your mind is restless, so what use is your posture?
You blow your horn, yet ever wander about.
ਗੁਰ ਗੋਰਖ ਕੀ; ਤੈ ਬੂਝ. ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
You have not understood the great Guru Gorakh, the Protector of the world;
such a yogi comes and goes again and again. ॥3॥
The one to whom the Master has become merciful
prays only to Him: O Guru, Lord of the world, my petition is at Your door.
The Name is my patched coat, the Name is my garment;
servant Nanak, such a yogi has become steady. ॥4॥
The one who has meditated on the Master day and night in this way
ਹੁਣਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਸਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੨॥੧੩॥
has now found the Guru, the Lord of the world. ॥1॥ Second Rahao ॥2॥13॥
He alone is the Doer and the Cause of all doing.
My Master is wise and all-knowing.
The one who meets Him through the Guru enjoys bliss. ॥1॥
Such is the sweet relish of the Lord, O brother;
only a rare one, turning to the Guru, has beheld it. ॥1॥ Rahao
His light is immaculate, His Name is nectar.
887: Drinking it, one becomes immortal and free of desire.
Body and mind become cool, and the Lord quenches the fire of craving.
Such ones become embodiments of bliss and are renowned in the world. ॥2॥
ਕਿਆ ਦੇਵਉ; ਜਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
What can I offer You, since everything is Yours?
I am ever a sacrifice to You, hundreds of thousands of times.
ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦੇ ਸਾਜਿਆ ॥
You fashioned me, giving me body, mind, soul and form,
and by the Guru's grace You have exalted me, the lowly. ॥3॥
Opening the doors of my mind, You have called me into Your presence,
and shown me Yourself as You are.
Nanak says: the veil has been completely torn away;
I am Yours, and You dwell in my mind. ॥4॥3॥14॥
The Guru who made me his servant and joined me to his service,
who placed the life-giving Name of the Lord in my mouth,
who himself removed all my anxiety,
ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ; ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
to that Guru I am ever a sacrifice. ॥1॥
O True Guru, you have fulfilled all my affairs.
O True Guru, the unceasing music of joy is playing within me. ॥1॥ Rahao
The Lord whose glory is deep and unfathomable,
whoever He gives patience to is in rapture.
The one whose bonds the Sovereign Lord has cut
ਸੋ ਨਰੁ ਬਹੁਰਿ; ਨ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
is not cast into births again. ॥2॥
The one within whom He Himself becomes manifest
is untouched by pain and sorrow.
The ruby, the jewel of the Name, falls into his lap,
ਸਗਲ ਕੁਟੰਬ; ਓਹੁ ਜਨੁ ਲੈ ਤਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
and he crosses over, taking all his family with him. ॥3॥
ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਭਰਮੁ; ਨ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
He has no doubt, no duality, no sense of another,
who worships the One Immaculate Lord alone.
Wherever I look, I see the merciful Lord Himself.
Nanak says: I have met God, the Source of bliss. ॥4॥4॥15॥
The notion that this body is mine has left my body;
God's will has become dear to me.
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ; ਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
Whatever He does seems sweet to my mind;
this wonder I have seen with my own eyes. ॥1॥
ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਜਾਨੀ ਰੇ; ਮੇਰੀ ਗਈ ਬਲਾਇ ॥
Now I have understood, and the witch of possessiveness has left me.
ਬੁਝਿ ਗਈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ. ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਮਮਤਾ; ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਲੀਓ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
My craving is quenched and my possessiveness removed; the perfect Guru has given me understanding. ॥1॥ Rahao
In his mercy the Guru has kept me in his refuge;
the Guru has made me grasp the Lord's feet.
Now that my mind is wholly steady,
I know the Guru and the Supreme Lord to be one. ॥2॥
ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕੀਨੋ; ਹਮ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ॥
Whoever the Lord has created, I am their servant,
for my God dwells in all.
No one is my enemy, no one my foe;
I walk arm in arm with all, as brothers of one Father. ॥3॥
ਜਾ ਕਉ; ਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਏ ਸੂਖਾ ॥
The one to whom the Guru, the Lord, has given peace
ਤਾ ਕਉ ਬਹੁਰਿ; ਨ ਲਾਗਹਿ ਦੂਖਾ ॥
is not afflicted by sorrow again.
Nanak, such a one is dyed in the love of the Lord of the world. ॥4॥5॥16॥
He reads the scriptures aloud with their commentaries,
but the Lord does not dwell in his heart, nor is his conduct pure.
He preaches to others and drives his teaching home,
but does not practise what he himself preaches. ॥1॥
O pandit, reflect on the Vedas, O pandit,
ਮਨ ਕਾ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and remove the anger from your mind, O pandit. ॥1॥ Rahao
He places the Saligram stone before him,
888: but his mind roams in all ten directions.
He applies the frontal mark and falls at the idol's feet,
but the blind man does all this only to please the world. ॥2॥
He performs the six Brahminical duties, keeps a prayer mat and wears a loincloth;
in the homes of the rich he reads his scripture every day;
he turns his rosary and begs for wealth.
ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ; ਕੋਇ. ਨ ਤਰਿਓ ਮੀਤ ॥੩॥
O friend, no one has ever crossed over in this way. ॥3॥
He alone is a pandit who lives by the Guru's Word;
ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਕੀ; ਓਸੁ ਉਤਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
the Maya of the three qualities has lost its hold on him.
For him the four Vedas are complete in the Lord's Name.
Millions of obstacles do not come near him;
ਅਨਿਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਹੈ; ਤਾ ਕੀ ਚੇਰਿ ॥
Maya of many forms is his handmaid;
the one on whom the Creator's mercy falls. ॥1॥
The one whose helper is the Lord
ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ; ਉਆ ਕੈ ਸਰੰਜਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
has all his many efforts fulfilled. ॥1॥ Rahao
Whom the Creator protects, what can a created being do to him?
By His grace even an ant conquers the whole world.
ਬੇਅੰਤ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਤਾ ਕੀ; ਕੇਤਕ ਬਰਨ ॥
His glory is infinite; how much of it can be described?
ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ; ਤਾ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ॥੨॥
Be a sacrifice, again and again, to His feet. ॥2॥
ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਕੀਆ; ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
He alone has done chanting, austerity and meditation,
he alone has given charity of many kinds,
he alone is the true devotee, approved in this age,
to whom the Master has given honour. ॥3॥
Joining the Guru's company, they are enlightened;
the Lord, the abode of poise and peace and the fulfiller of hopes,
in Him the perfect True Guru has given them faith;
Nanak, they have become servants of His servants. ॥4॥7॥18॥
whatever one does, that one reaps.
By one's own deeds one binds oneself,
and through the affairs of Maya one comes and goes. ॥1॥
ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਭਇਆ; ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
through the perfect Guru's word, light has dawned within them. ॥1॥ Rahao
Body, wealth and wife are a false expanse.
Fine horses and elephants will all pass away.
Kingdoms, pleasures and beauty are all false;
without the Name, all will turn to dust. ॥2॥
People stray in doubt and are proud in vain;
none of all this expanse goes with anyone.
In sorrow and joy the body grows old;
so the faithless man's life passes. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ; ਕਲਿ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
In this age the Lord's Name is the nectar;
this treasure is with the Guru.
Nanak, the one with whom the Guru, the Lord of the universe, is pleased
ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਮਈਆ; ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੯॥
has seen the beautiful Lord in every heart. ॥4॥8॥19॥
In that state the five kinds of music resound in full,
unceasing instruments play, wondrous and amazing.
There the saints, the people of the Lord, rejoice,
joined to the Supreme Lord, perfect and unattached. ॥1॥
It is the home of peace, poise and bliss.
ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਬੈਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ; ਤਹ ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਨਹੀ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Sitting in the holy company they sing His praises; there is no disease, no sorrow, no birth or death. ॥1॥ Rahao
There they remember only the Name;
rare are those who attain that resting place.
Love is their food, and His praise their support.
889: Their seat there is steady and immeasurable. ॥2॥
ਡਿਗਿ. ਨ ਡੋਲੈ; ਕਤਹੂ. ਨ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
They do not fall or waver, nor wander anywhere;
ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਕੋ ਇਹੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
by the Guru's grace a rare one attains this mansion.
ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਮੋਹ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾਲ ॥
There is no doubt, fear, attachment or net of Maya;
in the merciful Lord there is the trance where no thought of Maya arises. ॥3॥
He has no end or limit;
He Himself is hidden, and He Himself is the expanse.
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਦੁ ॥
The one within whom the taste of the Lord dwells,
Nanak, that cannot be described; it is wondrous. ॥4॥9॥20॥
Meeting the saints, the Supreme Lord has come into my mind.
Keeping their company, my mind has found contentment.
May my forehead ever rest at the saints' feet;
again and again I bow to the saints. ॥1॥
This mind is a sacrifice to the saints,
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਰਾਖੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
grasping whose support I have found peace; in their mercy they have protected me. ॥1॥ Rahao
Washing the saints' feet, I drink the water;
beholding the saints' sight, I live.
My mind rests its hope in the saints;
the saints are my pure wealth. ॥2॥
The saints have covered my faults and saved my honour;
ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਮੋਹਿ ਕਬਹੂ. ਨ ਕੜਦਾ ॥
by the saints' grace no worry ever troubles me.
The merciful Lord has given me the saints' company;
when the saints became my helpers, the Lord became merciful. ॥3॥
My awareness, mind and intellect are enlightened.
The deep, unfathomable, infinite Treasure of virtues,
the Sustainer of all beings and creatures,
Nanak, is delighted on seeing His saints. ॥4॥10॥21॥
ਤੇਰੈ ਕਾਜਿ ਨ; ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਮਾਲੁ ॥
Home, rule and wealth are of no use to you;
the entanglements of sensual things are of no use to you.
Know all dear friends to be a deception;
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਚਲੈ ॥੧॥
only the Lord's Name will go with you. ॥1॥
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਲੇ ਮੀਤਾ; ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ. ਤੇਰੀ ਲਾਜ ਰਹੈ ॥
Sing the praises of the Lord's Name, O friend; remembering the Lord, your honour is saved.
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ; ਜਮੁ ਕਛੁ. ਨ ਕਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Remembering the Lord, Death says nothing to you. ॥1॥ Rahao
Without the Lord, all deeds are useless.
Gold, silver and money are but dust.
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਜਾਪਿ; ਮਨ ਸੁਖਾ ॥
Repeat the Guru's Word, and your mind will be at peace;
here and hereafter your face will be radiant. ॥2॥
The great and greater ones grew weary of their works;
ਕਿਨ ਹੀ. ਨ ਕੀਏ; ਕਾਜ ਮਾਇਆ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
none ever completed the affairs of Maya.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਪੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
The rare one who repeats the Lord's Name,
The Name is the support of the Lord's devotees.
The saints have won the priceless game of life.
Whatever the Lord's saint does is approved.
Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to him. ॥4॥11॥22॥
You gather wealth and cause people pain;
it will be of no use to you, but will remain for others.
Proud and blinded, you go about,
ਜਮ ਕੀ ਜੇਵੜੀ; ਤੂ ਆਗੈ ਬੰਧ ॥੧॥
but hereafter you will be bound by Death's noose. ॥1॥
Give up your envy of others, O fool.
You are to stay here only for a night, O fool.
ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਮਾਤੇ; ਤੈ ਉਠਿ ਚਲਨਾ ॥
Intoxicated with Maya, you must rise and depart,
ਰਾਚਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਤੂ; ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਪਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
yet you are absorbed in a dream. ॥1॥ Rahao
In childhood the child is ignorant;
in the fullness of youth he is drawn to foul deeds;
890: in the third stage he gathers Maya;
and grown old, he leaves it and departs regretting. ॥2॥
After a long time one obtains this precious human body,
but without the Name it turns to dust.
Worse than beasts and ghosts is the fool
ਤਿਸਹਿ. ਨ ਬੂਝੈ; ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹ ਸਿਰੀ ॥੩॥
who does not know the One who made him. ॥3॥
Hear me, O Creator, Lord of the universe, Sustainer of the world,
merciful to the meek, ever compassionate:
only if You free them are beings released from their bonds.
Nanak, forgive this blind world and unite it with Yourself. ॥4॥12॥23॥
Bringing soul and body together, the Lord cut and fashioned the garment of the body;
the ignorant being stays absorbed in it.
He nurtures it and ever takes care of it,
but at the last moment he rises and departs. ॥1॥
Without the Name all is false, O mortal.
ਗੋਵਿਦ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ. ਅਵਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੂਠੁ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Those who, without meditating on the Lord, are absorbed in other things are all robbed by Maya, O mortal. ॥1॥ Rahao
Bathing at pilgrim places this filth is not washed off.
All such religious rites are but the spread of ego.
By pleasing people, salvation is not attained.
Those without the Name will depart weeping. ॥2॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ; ਨ ਟੂਟਸਿ ਪਟਲ ॥
Without the Lord's Name the veil is not torn,
even by studying all the Shastras and Simritis.
ਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ; ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਜਪਾਏ ॥
He alone repeats the Name whom the Lord Himself inspires;
such ones receive all fruits and stay absorbed in peace. ॥3॥
O Protector, You Yourself protect us.
All comforts are in Your hands, O God.
To whatever You attach us, to that we are attached, O Master.
Nanak, the Master knows all hearts. ॥4॥13॥24॥
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ; ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
Whatever the Lord does, he knows it as peace;
his ignorant mind has come to trust in the holy company.
Held steady, it has ceased to waver,
and taking the True Name, has merged in the True One. ॥1॥
All his pain is gone, all his disease is gone;
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਨੀ; ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
he has accepted God's will in his mind, having met the Great Being, the Guru. ॥1॥ Rahao
All his efforts are pure, all his deeds spotless;
whatever the Lord brings about seems good to him.
Wherever the Lord keeps him is for him the place of liberation;
whatever He has him repeat, that is the Name. ॥2॥
ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ; ਜਹ ਸਾਧ ਪਗ ਧਰਹਿ ॥
Where the holy set their feet are the sixty-eight pilgrim places;
where they utter the Name is heaven.
Beholding their sight, there is every bliss;
ਰਾਮ ਗੁਣਾ; ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
there one sings the Lord's praises day after day. ॥3॥
The Lord Himself pervades every heart;
the glory of the merciful Being is manifest.
The doors have opened, and doubts have fled far away;
Nanak has met the perfect Guru. ॥4॥14॥25॥
The fruit of millions of chants and austerities comes to dwell in him;
wealth, wisdom, miraculous powers and godlike understanding are his;
he enjoys countless forms, colours and delights,
in whose heart, through the Guru, the Name dwells even for an instant. ॥1॥
The greatness of the Lord's Name
cannot be described; its worth cannot be told. ॥1॥ Rahao
He is a warrior and a hero against vice, patient and perfect in understanding,
